archetypes.name: dyn-progress
archetypes.rationale: Review breadcrumb placement without changing plan-review wire output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed plan-review round path for progress breadcrumb placement. Verify the breadcrumbs are emitted before the intended subprocess milestones, stay scoped to design step 3, and do not alter KEY=value stdout or prune behavior. Pay special attention to early-return paths and the empty paths-file collection skip. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
